def tmsegs(p, w=19, thr=1.6):
    hp = [sum(code_h[a] for a in p[i:i+w])/w for i in range(len(p)-w+1)]
    segs=[]; cur=None
    for i,h in enumerate(hp):
        if h>thr:
            if cur and i-segs[-1][-1]<=2: pass
    peaks=[i for i,h in enumerate(hp) if h>thr]
    out=[]
    for p_i in peaks:
        if out and p_i-out[-1][-1]<=2: out[-1].append(p_i)
        else: out.append([p_i])
    return [(s[0]+1, s[-1]+w, max(hp[s[0]:s[-1]+1])) for s in out]

## Report on `region_011` (region.fasta)

**Sample & global composition**

- Length: **3,000 bp**
- Base counts: T = 806, A = 758, C = 735, G = 701
- Overall GC = **47.9%** (fairly uniform; no CpG island — CpG observed/expected = 0.87)
- No long homopolymer runs, no long direct repeats, no significant inverted repeats:

Notable features:

| Region | Object | Details |
|---|---|---|
| 1–3000 | full fragment | GC 47.9%, no CpG islands; GC skewed locally (55–61%) at ~1400–1900 bp |
| **1161–2177** | **Protein-coding-looking ORF, + strand, frame 3** | ATG start, TGA stop, 337 aa, ~51 kDa, no internal stops. Highly GC-biased 3rd codon positions (71% GC) → strong codon-usage bias. Almost Arg/Gln-rich downstream half and a **single Cys**. No P-loop / Walker A motif ⇒ not an obvious NTPase. Lacks a good Shine–Dalgarno box ~4–20 nt upstream (best 3/6 match to "AGGAGG" at −15: "ACAAGT") ⇒ weakly bacterial-like |
| 237–953 | ORF, **– strand, frame 2**, 238 aa | Predicted ~34 kDa. N-terminus `MSNNVKLLIAGSAFFAMSAQA…` — basic residue + hydrophobic core + "AQA…" pattern, consistent with a Type I signal peptide/leader (secreted candidate), although hydrophobicity is only moderate (max 19-aa hydrophobicity ≈ 1.09, below typical TM threshold) |
| 845–856 | 12-bp perfect palindrome `AAGCTGCAGCTT` | contains the **PvuII** site (CAGCTG); only short perfect repeat detected |
| 2215–2694 | ORF, – strand, frame 1, 159 aa | Short hydrophilic protein (~23 kDa), 3 Cys, ends `…TASIREGANKRGNSSRLTQSFHFFMFEPIFSPVNALNQPI` |
| ~2691–2996 | ORF, – strand, frame 2, 306 bp (predicted ~101 aa) | small protein candidate at 3'-end of fragment |
| 1–1160 & 2178–3000 flanking | intergenic-looking regions | no other long ORFs, no repeats, average GC |

**Interpretation**
The region is dominated by a single gene-like ORF (1161–2177 bp) coding for a 337-aa protein (~51 kDa) with unusual codon-usage bias (71% GC at wobble positions while region A/T-rich overall) — a pattern typical of organisms with either strong translational selection or a sub-genome compositonal peculiarity. Two other candidate ORFs on the complementary strand each begin with a small N-terminal positive-charged/hydrophobic "leader" consensus (signal peptide-like), suggesting possible secreted products. Overall the region looks like a compact cluster of ORFs, not an intergenic patch — despite the modest GC%.
